QuestInfo.name: [Sia Astelle] Traces of Sadalsuud
QuestInfo.0: The boy searching for stars said that he obtained information from an information dealer. Perhaps one can help you.
QuestInfo.1: Something strange has happened at the Verne Mine, hideout of the Black Wings. You should go check it out.
QuestInfo.2: The Black Wings were conducting experiments at the Verne Mine to artificially warp people's pure wishes with malice, only for a guard robot to malfunction thanks to #p9402192#.\r\nYou recovered #p9402192# from Isaac, the boy who had been trying to find stars. When you told him your story, he decided to help you search for the remaining stars.
